newsitem.title: USA: Spectrum sets one-for-75 reverse split.
newsitem.headline: Spectrum sets one-for-75 reverse split.

text.p: Spectrum Information Technologies Inc said Thursday its Chapter 11 plan of reorganization should go into effect March 31 and includes a one-for-75 reverse stock split.
On April 1, reorganized Spectrum common stock will trade under the symbol "SITI," Spectrum said. Its reorganized common stock is likely to continue trading on the OTC Bulletin Board, it said.
Spectrum said it presently has 76,675,448 common shares outstanding.
The company said about one million new shares of Class A preferred stock will be delivered to a trustee to be distributed to plaintiffs to settle a class action lawsuit brought against it in 1993.
The Class A stock will be convertible to reorganized common stock for two years.
Spectrum also said about 227,000 new shares of reorganized common stock will be issued to cover incentive plans for its employees.
